description:
Delete an AI Tracker (Brand Radar) prompt and all of its recorded engine responses. This is irreversible. promptId is the prompt UUID (from list_prompts). The prompt's topic is left untouched. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// delete a tracked prompt
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","promptId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"}
```
name: delete_prompt
title: Delete prompt
